    Separated-quiver arguments under MildHyp #

    An arrow (irreducible morphism) never factors through a non-irreducible τ, and distinct arrows with a common source (or target) never factor through each other. Hence a crown made of arrows — a cycle in the separated quiver — cleaves into every proper residue P/τ with τ not irreducible, which MildHyp excludes (MildHyp.not_arrow_crown2, MildHyp.not_arrow_crown3).

    ¬FactorsThroughMorphism τ e
